spec.label: Human temporal L2/3; active Fig.3c model

operating_point.condition: Original active channels and morphology retained. Fixed somatic holding current selects a stable low-spike operating point; identical current and reference state used by all solver comparisons.
operating_point.weight_selection: Reference-only 250E 10Hz mean depolarization approximately 2.5mV, before fitting/testing.
operating_point.reference_selection: Predetermined same-input 0.025/0.05/0.1ms convergence pilot; .1ms requires spiking coverage, masked max-case RMSE <=.03mV and exact +/-5ms event matching.

event_training_protocol.architecture: Same per-site filters and event reset; trainable full quadratic matrix; diagonal starts zero
event_training_protocol.initialization: Exact archived per-cell voltage-fit checkpoint used by the original event trainer; not the later random-init experiment
event_training_protocol.data_policy: Reuse exact archived fit/validation manifest including existing prefixes; no new output-based selection. No test input evaluated by this trainer
event_training_protocol.candidate_policy: Preserve original training path; retain best positive-update joint/voltage snapshots and last state, in addition to original candidates. After full training, reset-calibrate ON/OFF pairs with identical shared threshold grid, source-reset anchor, candidate-reset warm start, amp/tau grid and local refinement. Validation only
event_training_protocol.optimizer: AdamW wd1e-6; cosine to 2% LR; clip 1; EMA .995; FP32 IEEE
event_training_protocol.voltage_loss: Original variance-balanced masked MSE + 0.1 squared physical derivative error; ref AP +/-10ms excluded
event_training_protocol.event_loss: lambda*(positive threshold hinge at nearest reference event sample + mean per-trace top-4 non-event hinge); margin .15 mV; negatives exclude reference +/-5 ms and padded tails
event_training_protocol.reset: Teacher reset fixed per stage; validation calibration; rebuilt residual before refinement
event_training_protocol.calibration: Bias+.025 through +24 mV, empirical validation pre-event levels, old reset; amp 4/8/12 and tau 8/16/40 ms, with local threshold refinement
event_training_protocol.validation_selection: Min pooled masked MSE + .02 normalized MSE + .25*(1-F1@5ms), among candidates within original validation RMSE + max(.05 mV,25%); old locked candidate retained

voltage_fit_protocol.input_selection: NEURON-only 0–3 reference spikes, minimum ISI 20ms; one longest eligible 6/4/2/1s prefix per independent source seed. Original fit/validation group retained. Valid-time mask excludes padded tail. No surrogate errors used.
voltage_fit_protocol.training_loss: Per-case masked MSE weighted by 0.3+0.7/max(reference variance,0.04), normalized over fit cases; +0.1 similarly weighted squared physical derivative error.
voltage_fit_protocol.validation_selection: Pooled masked MSE + 0.02 mean normalized MSE (variance floor .04) + .05*(1-event F1); common 1ms observation grid; events at +/-5ms.
voltage_fit_protocol.reset_training: Teacher reset initially fixed; select calibrated reset on validation; rebuild teacher residual and refine for 400 epochs.
voltage_fit_protocol.dataset: Independent ca1 ampa panels: base 1ms events and added native fine-time Poisson events; original architecture; fit and validation seeds fixed before testing.
